acceptance: Explorer views show headline, block, workload, correctness, variance, reference, and full concurrency-curve evidence.
The complete cohort key and methodology version are visible and used for comparison filtering.
Invalid, missing, unsupported, or non-comparable results cannot appear as valid ranked scores.
Documentation states that BenchBox scores are synthetic and are not official TPC metrics.
Existing benchmark-specific and official TPC metrics remain available without semantic changes.
Publication tests prevent provisional or unqualified methodology versions from reaching public score surfaces.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. The ADR's numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, and M4 reference are pilot hypotheses until the methodology-freeze item closes.
description: Add a separate Results Explorer and documentation surface for qualified BenchBox-Power and BenchBox-Throughput scores. Do not reinterpret the existing meta-leaderboard or expose provisional pilot results as headline scores.
